flags.message: Conditioning caution: the frozen elevated band and distribution_count=2 include a pre-conference reschedule, not an observed post-conference relist. The September 30 distribution for October 16 was rescheduled October 6, then distributed October 7 for November 6; both conferences postdate the October 11 snapshot. Context is as-stored with no cutoff. I retained the supplied band and count but discounted any inference of prior conference consideration.

A material positive signal is the provisioned September 30 reply's report that the Solicitor General urged review in related Nwauzor litigation and referenced this case. This is pre-snapshot advocacy, not an outcome. I did not independently retrieve that brief or either case's later history; the forecast distinguishes related federal support from a CVSG or grant recommendation on this docket.
